note: Character models. A null glb means the engine sculpts the model procedurally (SDF + surface nets) on the same rig. Drop a rigged GLB (bone names as in src/assets/heroModel.ts, Draco or meshopt geometry, KTX2 textures) under public/assets/models/ and point glb at it; run `node scripts/copy-decoders.mjs` once so the decoders ship with the build.
